sentences.en: There's a soda machine at the end of the hall.
sentences.zh: 走廊尽头有一台卖汽水的自动售货机。

sentences.en: I don't like soda and I don't like beer, either.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢喝汽水也不喜欢啤酒。

sentences.en: Two sodas for the children and one coffee, please.
sentences.zh: 请给我两瓶孩子们的汽水和一杯咖啡。

senses.zh: 苏打, 纯碱, 苏打汽水（加果味，有时加入冰淇淋）, 无水碳酸钠
